description: Use this when the user asks about their Fantasy Premier League chips: 'should I bench boost this week?', 'when should I triple captain?', 'which chips do I have left?', 'should I wildcard?'. Says which chips they have left in this window (GW1-19 or GW20-38), whether to play one this gameweek, and the best one coming up, by our model. Needs the team ID (for the chips already played; reuse it if the user gave it earlier in this conversation) or all 15 names.

bank.description: With players only: money in the bank, £m. Default 0.

captain.description: With players only: the user's captain, one of the 15.

players.description: Without a team ID: all 15 player names from the user's squad, e.g. read from a screenshot of their Pick Team or Points page, bench included. All 15 are needed: if the screenshot is cropped, ask the user for the rest before calling.

team.description: The user's FPL team ID: the number after /entry/ in the address of their FPL Points page (fantasy.premierleague.com/entry/1234567/event/6). The whole link works too. Once the user has given it, reuse it for every later question in this conversation; don't ask again.
